analysis.change_threshold: deterministic candidates require >40 dB or +2 dB over R0 best (36.67 dB); noise candidates require WEAK->PARTIAL/MATCH signal improvement
analysis.rationale: R1 closed every remaining deterministic blur severity-grid gap left open by R0 (lens 1/3/4, gaussian 1). None exceeded 33.49 dB, far below both the 36.67 dB (+2 dB) and >40 dB exact-match thresholds. Quantization is ruled out by unique_per_channel=228/230/214 (quantization functions collapse to 20/15/10/6/3 or 24/16/8/6/4 levels per channel), JPEG by block_boundary=1.0052 (0%-FP signal; R0 glass2+jpeg1/2 fell to 32.10/31.29), global changes by severity magnitudes (mildest contrast_weaken_scale:1 implies variance_ratio~0.56 vs observed 0.868; brightness shift sev1=25.5 levels vs mean_shift=-0.5; saturation weaken sev1=0.6-0.7 vs chroma_ratio=0.9657), and motion by residual_anisotropy=1.203<1.7. The ~34-35 dB PSNR ceiling is only compatible with the stochastic glass pixel-shuffle; blur_glass:2 remains the best-supported candidate (34.67 dB, repeat 34.64 dB, CI 10/10, verify_signals MATCH).
analysis.noise_note: R0's NO_NOISE argument (min sev1 noise sigma 12.75 >> peeled residual sigma 2-3) does not hold if noise precedes blur (blind_challenge forces noise priority 0 before blur priority 1; glass internal gaussian sigma 0.7-1.6 attenuates sigma 12.75 to ~1.5-3). However no positive noise signal exists (peeled residual spatial_corr=0.95, structured), and R0 glass:2 verify_signals is already MATCH, so a noise candidate cannot meet the WEAK->PARTIAL/MATCH rule on the single pair. Recorded as unidentifiable-under-noise->blur, not proven absent.
analysis.single_pair_limitation: k=1 (pair0 only): no cross-pair verification possible; +2 dB threshold not relaxed; glass:2 repeat stability 0.03 dB.
